title: BMX
description:
Grind rails, chain tricks into Tony Hawk style combos, and score points on a BMX with real physics underneath. Lean to steer, pedal up the ramps, flip, and land it.

WHAT YOU GET
- Grinds on any map, automatically: hop onto a pipe for a Crank Grind, or onto a ledge or coping edge for a Double Peg Grind. Sparks and scrape included, no map setup.
- Combos: chain tricks (air into a grind, the grind into a manual) and land it for a bonus. Bail and the bonus is gone.
- Scored tricks with on-screen callouts: wheelies, manuals, stoppies, bunny hops, front flips, back flips, barrel rolls and 360s.
- Ten bikes: BMX (20-inch street), BMX Cruiser (24-inch, longer, faster at the top end), Mini BMX (16-inch, short, light and quick), a 700c Road Bike (eight gears, drop bars, about 1.6x the BMX top speed, tricks score x1.5), a Fixie (the cranks are locked to the rear wheel: skid stops, fakies and trackstands), a City Bike (upright, heavy, coaster brake, a basket that keeps small props in while you ride gently, and a child seat), a Unicycle (one wheel, balanced by pedalling and leaning, with an assist you can turn down), a Penny-Farthing (a huge front wheel, the rider up high, and a hard front brake takes you over the bars), a Tandem (two seats, both pedalling) and a long-travel Downhill Bike.
- A bike rack that welds to a car and carries two bikes, and a bike lock (a weapon) that locks a parked bike to the ground for roleplay: only you or an admin can unlock it.
- A skateboard (Boards tab): push, carve, ollie, nine flip tricks with a catch window, ten grinds and slides, manuals with a balance meter, grabs, reverts, powerslides and switch. Carry it with the Skateboard weapon.
- A kick scooter (Scooters tab): kick to push, a rear fender brake, bunny hop, tailwhip, barspin, bri flip, flips, manuals and 50-50, smith and feeble grinds.
- Inline skates (the Skates weapon): stride, crossover, T-stop, jump, and soul, mizou and backslide grinds, with spins scored on the landing.
- Real handling: steering comes from leaning, the way a real bike turns. Suspension soaks up landings, kerbs roll up, and the bike stays planted on banks and ramps.
- Water: wheels drag in it, it splashes, and you are thrown off when it reaches your chest.
- A bell (R), a wind whoosh that grows with speed, and a freewheel tick when you coast.
- A drawn-in-code bike: painted frame, real tyres, chrome pegs, brake cable with a detangler, pedals geared to the rear wheel. The rider sits, grips and pedals, and crashes as a ragdoll of their own player model (RagMod is supported if you have it).
- 14 paint colours, and a GTA-style cinematic camera that keeps filming through a crash.

CONTROLS
E  get on (picks up a fallen bike); on the back of a ridden BMX or cruiser, E gets you on its pegs; on the back of a tandem, E takes the second seat (W pedals)
W / S  pedal / rear brake   (in the air: nose down / nose up)
A / D  lean to steer   (in the air: roll; off a vertical ramp: turn round to ride back down)
SPACE  hold and release to hop; tap to hop off a grind
Right mouse  weight back: wheelie or manual
Left mouse  front brake: stoppie   (in the air, with A / D: tailwhip)
CTRL + left mouse  lean forward over the bars; let go of the mouse with CTRL held to keep a nose manual rolling
R  ring the bell (on the ground)   (in the air or a manual: barspin)
ALT  hold in the air or a manual: W / S / A / D / SPACE strike a style pose
SHIFT  sprint   CTRL  tuck
Unicycle: W / S pedal forward and back (no brake: S pedals backwards), A / D lean, the mouse twists you round, SPACE hops
Penny-farthing: left mouse is the front brake, and hard at speed it is a header
E on a bike on a rack lets it down; E on a rack with a bike beside it loads it. Bike lock: left click locks the bike you aim at, right click unlocks it
] / [ or mouse wheel  shift gear up / down (road bike)
K  next paint colour (puff of smoke)   L  cinematic camera
Hold C and right-click a bike: pick any colour
Gamepad: the stick is analog, half stick is half lean.
SKATEBOARD  W push, S foot brake, A / D carve (CTRL + A / D powerslide), hold SPACE and release to ollie (ALT: nollie), then W / A / S / D pick a flip; in the air RMB + direction grabs and CTRL + A / D spins; RMB on the ground is a manual (W / S balance); hold SPACE in the air near a rail or ledge to grind (A / D balance), release to pop out; A / D on touchdown reverts; left mouse switches stance.
SCOOTER  W kick, S rear fender brake, A / D lean to steer, SPACE hop; in the air left mouse + A / D tailwhip, R barspin (left mouse + R both), W / S flip (a tailwhip with a flip is a bri flip), right mouse on the ground a manual; land on a rail for a 50-50, on a ledge's edge with W a smith or with S a feeble.
SKATES  equip the Skates weapon (or bmx_spawn skates): W stride, A / D crossover (the view turns), S T-stop, SPACE jump; hold SPACE in the air near a rail to grind (W a mizou, across it a backslide; A / D balance, release SPACE to pop off); spin in the air for a 180 or 360; a hard or sideways landing is a bail.

SERVER OWNERS
bmx_max_per_player N  bikes one player may have out (0 = no limit of ours)
bmx_scoring 0  no scoring at all
bmx_combos 0  trick points, but no combo bonus
bmx_fixie_frontbrake 1  LMB brakes the front wheel of a fixie too
bmx_unicycle_assist 0..1  how much of the unicycle's balance is done for the rider (default 0.6; 0 is as hard as the real thing)
bmx_passengers 0  nobody can ride on the pegs or in a child seat
bmx_sounds 0  mute every bike sound for everyone
bmx_bell 0  no bell;  bmx_bell_cooldown <seconds>  time between rings
bmx_water 0  water changes nothing;  bmx_water_eject 0  riders are not thrown off in deep water
bmx_ragmod 0  never hand crashed riders to RagMod
bmx_crash_ragdoll 0  the plain shove instead of a ragdoll tumble
bmx_air_assist 0  no air turn, landing aim or spine transfer off vertical ramps
bmx_nose_manual 1  allow nose manuals (off until ridden on your server)

PLAYER CONSOLE
bmx_spawn [stock|cruiser|mini|road|fixie|city|unicycle|penny|tandem|dh|skateboard|scooter|skates]  spawn a bike (or find BMX in the Entities tab)
bmx_color <name>  paint your bike
bmx_vol_ride / bmx_vol_wind / bmx_vol_bell  your own volumes, 0 to 1
bmx_stick_deadzone  gamepad stick deadzone (default 0.1)
bmx_lmb_mode lean  left mouse leans forward instead of braking (CTRL + left mouse then brakes)
bmx_skates_brake tstop|heel  how S stops you on skates;  bmx_stance regular|goofy  your skateboard stance;  bmx_board_flick 1  flick the mouse for flips;  bmx_board_autogrind 1  grind on contact
bmx_lod_scale  bike detail by distance (0 = always full)
bmx_report  prints a block to paste into a bug report
bmx_debug 1  live physics telemetry (2 also draws each part's axes)

Base Garry's Mod only: nothing to mount, no content from other games. Server-authoritative, works in singleplayer and on servers. MIT licensed.
